title: Projective modules and vanishing of their Ext groups
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $P$ an $R$-module. Then $P$ is projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module] if and only if $\operatorname{Ext}^1_R(P,Y)=0$ [def-pc-ext] for every $R$-module $Y$. If $P$ is projective, then $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(P,Y)=0$ for every $R$-module $Y$ and every integer $i\ge1$.
